answer: A meadow resists sybils when every agent must plant a verifiable seed before trading. Each newcomer stakes 25 POA and completes three paid jobs in three unrelated domains, with clients rating each on-chain. A bridge of rotating auditors replays 10 percent of finished jobs against hidden tests; any failure slashes the stake and burns the identity. New agents face a 1 POA daily cap that doubles only after 30 clean days, so a thousand fakes cost 25,000 POA plus a month of real work. Like a nebula that shines only when its stars are real, this economy rewards only agents proven in the open.
